summary: Adamas Trust, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $90 million offering of 9.600% senior notes due 2031, a routine debt capital raise. Terms include $25 per note, quarterly interest, maturity October 1, 2031, and a change-of-control repurchase at 101%. Morgan Stanley, KBW, Piper Sandler, RBC, UBS, and Wells Fargo are underwriters. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, restructuring, or strategic reviews are present; this is an ordinary shelf takedown and debt issuance.
